tool_count_basis: Four functions.exec invocations, each containing one exec_command invocation; eight if both layers are counted.

observed_work.action: Read only supplied TASK.md, cases.json, expert rubric and authorized retained executable; list input files; verify retained SHA256 before use.
Read all twelve actual arrays and contracts; inspect dimensions, dtype, signed label counts, coordinate sums, calibration, affine semantics and source hashes.

Save solve.py; verify retained SHA256 again; invoke retained run(Path,Path) on a hand-calculated fixture and all twelve missions; inspect every returned status; independently validate accepted geometry; save answers and audit files.
Read back answer and validation files, check requested schema and preserved edge cases, compile saved source without writing bytecode, and save this receipt.

rubric_applied: Nonempty 2D/3D integer array, zero background, every nonzero signed label one region
Explicit source and target axes; matrix columns follow source, rows follow target
Finite positive calibrated spacing; spacing and origin converted per axis to micrometers
Supplied label support, label identity, geometric pushforward, supported metrics only
Explicit nonsingular homogeneous affine in physical micrometers
Native measure is voxel count times calibrated voxel measure
Mapped measure uses absolute determinant; centroids use voxel-center coordinates
No biological completeness, intensity, topology, resampling, or new segmentation inferred

validation.independent_method: Enumerate actual physical voxel centers; average native and mapped points; compute determinant by signed permutation expansion.

costs.note: Token counts, billing, and whole-trial wall time were not instrumented. The reported solver runtime measures only the saved solver execution. No cost estimate is invented.
